# pheno-secret-scan

> Centralized secret-scanning policy (trufflehog allowlist + pre-commit hooks) for the pheno-* family

**Type:** Policy repo (no code, no build, no test)
**Version:** 0.1.0
**Status:** L1 stabilized (V19 EXTENSION)

## Install

```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml in the consuming repo
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/KooshaPari/pheno-secret-scan
    rev: v0.1.0
    hooks:
      - id: pheno-secret-scan-trufflehog
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# Run the scanner against your repo
trufflehog filesystem --config .trufflehog-allowlist.txt .

# Or via pre-commit
pre-commit run pheno-secret-scan-trufflehog --all-files
```

## Public API

- `.trufflehog-allowlist.txt` — list of regex patterns that are explicitly allowed
- `.pre-commit-hooks.yaml` — pre-commit hook definitions (2 hooks: trufflehog + gitleaks)
- `.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml` — CI workflow that runs on every push
- `README.md` — full documentation of the allowlist schema

## Scope-Out

- Does not handle runtime secret rotation (use Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
- Does not handle encrypted-at-rest storage (use `pheno-encrypt-at-rest`)
- Does not handle per-PR secret detection (use GitHub Advanced Security)
